sentences.text: Gold loans are governed by the bank’s Gold Loan Operational Guidelines, read with the Retail Loan Policy.
The policy says processing fee and documentation charges are recovered as applicable at the time of sanction.
The evidence does not state a specific processing-fee amount for gold loans.
Other loan documents in the evidence show different processing-fee amounts for other products, but they do not provide a gold-loan processing fee.

missing.searched: Searched the bank’s gold loan policy and FAQ, plus other product fee tables and sanction letters, but found no gold-loan processing-fee amount.
